data.name: Muhaddisa
data.gender_notes: Muhaddisa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Female scholar, someone who memorizes and teaches the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Muhaddisa carries the meaning “Scholar, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muhaddisa usually hope their child will grow to embody scholar, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Someone who dedicates their life to the pursuit and sharing of sacred knowledge, inspiring others on their spiritual journey
data.etymology: Muhaddisa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Scholar, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaddisa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: المحدثسة
in_arabic.meaning: المحدثسة: المرأة الصادقة المتفانية بالعلم والعمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحدثسة: لفظ عربي يصف المرأة التي تعاني وتصبر وتؤمن في ظل الحصار والمحن والمصاعب، وهي من أبرز سمات السابقات في الإسلام، ويعد اسم المحدثسة من أسماء المرأة التي تتميز بالصبر والصلاح في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: المحدثسة
in_urdu.meaning: المحدثسة: ایک سچے اور جسے علم وعمل میں پوری دلائی دیتے ہوئے خاتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: المحدثسة: ایک سچے اور جسے علم وعمل میں پوری دلائی دیتے ہوئے خاتون جو اپنے گھر کے کاموں میں مصروف رہتی ہوں اور اپنی خواہشات کو پورا کرنے کی کوشش کرتی ہو، اس کا نام المحدثسة ہے، جو ایک مسلمان خاتون کے لیے ایک بہترین انتخاب ہے

in_hindi.name: मुहद्दिसा
in_hindi.meaning: मुहद्दिसा: एक सच्ची और जो ज्ञान और कार्य में पूरी दिलाई देती है महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहद्दिसा: एक सच्ची और जो ज्ञान और कार्य में पूरी दिलाई देती है महिला जो अपने घर के कामों में व्यस्त रहती है और अपनी इच्छाओं को पूरा करने की कोशिश करती है, इसका नाम मुहद्दिसा है, जो एक मुस्लिम महिला के लिए एक अच्छा विकल्प है

in_pashto.name: المحدثسة
in_pashto.meaning: المحدثسة: دا سچی او دا علم او کار پوهېدونکې ښځه
in_pashto.long_meaning: المحدثسة: دا سچی او دا علم او کار پوهېدونکې ښځه چې په خپل کور کې کار کوي او په خپلې خوښې د کار او علم په څانګه کې پوهېږي، دا نام المحدثسة يې دا ښځه لپاره په افغانستان او پښتونخوا کې دا ښځې ته اړوند دي

in_english.name: Muhaddisa

in_english.long_meaning: Muhaddisa: a truthful and diligent woman in knowledge and work, characterized by patience and perseverance, one of the most important values in Islam, a comprehensive and multifaceted name that encompasses various aspects of a Muslim woman's personality and character

data.cultural_impact: The title "Muhaddisa" holds great cultural importance in Islamic society as it is bestowed upon women who have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of knowledge and have achieved a significant level of understanding in Islamic studies. This title signifies a high level of academic proficiency and respect within the community. Muhaddisas, through their education and teaching, contribute to the preservation and continuation of Islamic traditions, customs, and values. Their roles in mosques, madrasas (Islamic schools), and educational institutions serve to inspire future generations of scholars.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "Muhaddisa" holds great spiritual significance as it represents a deep connection to the Prophet Muhammad and the religious knowledge he imparted. Muhaddisas embody the Islamic values of seeking knowledge and striving for excellence in understanding the teachings of the faith. Their commitment to education and scholarship allows them not just to preserve the teachings but to also convey them to others, enriching the spiritual growth and enlightenment of those they teach. The pursuit of knowledge inherently promotes humility, patience, and the love of God, as the acquisition of knowledge is a lifelong process that requires dedication and perseverance. Thus, being addressed as a Muhaddisa serves as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and staying faithful to the teachings of the faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Scholar, Knowledgeable" symbolizes Female scholar, someone who memorizes and teaches the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhaddisa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of scholar, knowledgeable.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muhaddisa is mentioned in the book 'The History of the Arabs' by Al-Tabari. The name Muhaddisa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Muhaddisa is associated with the early Islamic period, specifically during the Abbasid Caliphate.
